about: Classes 3.0 step 1b (docs/design/rev4-primitives.md rows 7 to 11, section 6, the step 1a review's list): one fixture item per primitive, written in data only, loaded with addItems() / addConditions() by test/prim-*.test.ts. Test only: not game content. The tests read their numbers from here.

relics.name: Steady Line (test)
relics.text: Allies within {=effects.0.targets.within} tiles of you have {=effects.0.value} more reaction a round while you stand (a standing aura: P5).

relics.name: Witnessed Dread (test)
relics.text: When you kill, every enemy within {=effects.0.targets.within} tiles of the body with a line of sight to it saves against your Will Power or is Shaken.

relics.name: Foe's habit (test)
relics.text: After its own action, it marks it (the trigger acted, fired by the enemy AI too).

relics.name: Sure Mark (test)
relics.text: Any roll to hit a Marked enemy, a weapon's, a Sigil's or an Outburst's, gets +{=effects.0.value}; a Sigil's +{=effects.1.value} more.
